name: liab-cli
description: Lab-in-a-Box skill toolbox: pyinfra deployment planning and (on an explicit target-naming instruction) application, forgejo repository creation on an instance that already runs, plus the offline check the liab doer runs first. Plan-by-default is a constraint rather than a preference here, because the blast radius is a machine rather than a working tree — and a green pyinfra run means the operations applied, not that the service serves. Standing an instance up stays in the declarative deployment; a host configured by ad hoc commands cannot be rebuilt.
